response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 15+ years of experience and strong software craftsmanship practices, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. His C++ experience is minimal (6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015), with his entire career focused on web, backend, and scripting languages. More critically, he lacks any demonstrated knowledge of industrial automation, cybersecurity standards (SDL, IEC 62443), or industrial protocols—all central to this position. His expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and architecture design does not offset the substantial gap in both the primary technical skill (C++) and the industrial domain.
strengths: Exceptional software craftsmanship with proven mastery of TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and clean code practices across senior roles
Strong system architecture and design experience including event-driven platforms, microservices, and distributed systems
Demonstrated mentoring and teaching capability with public conference talks, workshops, and code dojo leadership
concerns: Severely limited C++ experience (6 months in 2014-2015); primary expertise is JavaScript/TypeScript and web-backend development, not systems programming
No evidence of industrial automation, IoT device development, or industrial cybersecurity domain knowledge (SDL, IEC 62443, industrial protocols)
Career trajectory is web and platform-focused; lacks experience with multi-threaded systems, networked embedded applications, or real-time performance constraints typical of industrial machinery
